hook: Three Indigenous narratives rewrite Australia's history, sparking nationwide fallout.

sections.voiceover: Three Indigenous narratives rewrite Australia's history, sparking nationwide fallout.
sections.visual_cue: Three bold text cards displaying the narrative titles.

sections.voiceover: On Oct 29 2026, ABC News aired Address to the Nations, a series rewriting Australian history. Creators David Pledger, Tony Briggs and Sherry‑Lee Watson built the project highlighting Indigenous history. Will it stick?
sections.visual_cue: Timeline graphic of the Oct 29 2026 broadcast with portrait thumbnails of the three creators.

sections.voiceover: But the series also ignited fierce backlash from conservative groups.
sections.visual_cue: Red protest signs clash with the series logo on screen.

sections.voiceover: The series sparked a nationwide debate, forcing Australians to confront rewritten history. Indigenous leaders praised the platform for finally centering First Nations voices. ABC News reported the project is reshaping public discourse across Australia.
sections.visual_cue: Map of Australia overlaid with debate icons and photos of Indigenous leaders.

sections.voiceover: Three Indigenous narratives now challenge Australia's history.
sections.visual_cue: Closing title card summarizing the three narratives against a backdrop of the Australian continent.
